delivery.outcome: A Docker monorepo with root Compose and explicitly declared nested Dockerfiles can truthfully enable the docker stack without adding a synthetic root Dockerfile
nonGoals: No recursive Dockerfile auto-discovery or weakening of explicit pin validation
No mutation of downstream Docker configuration or images
No dependency, package version, Goal or external delivery change

architecture.decision: Recognize conventional root Compose files as Docker stack markers while retaining an explicit manifest list for every Dockerfile and Compose file whose image references are validated
architecture.rollback: Revert before candidate publication; compose-only roots again require a synthetic marker or omit the stack

validation.evidence: Root docker-compose.yml plus an explicitly listed nested Dockerfile reaches GOV-PASS
A nested Dockerfile without any root Docker/Compose marker remains GOV-STACK-001

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
